highest_roi_next_integrations.why: Best immediate public bridge for external response-context stress without pretending it is the same label.
Broad public imaging cohort with receptor/pathology/treatment/follow-up context for schema discipline.
Closest future bridge for treatment-history plus genomic/outcome context, but access and target mismatch remain blockers.
Useful to make synthetic CBC/lab noise less clean, while staying explicit that it is not breast-response data.
Improves unsafe-genetics eval coverage without giving patient-specific variant interpretation.

recommended_sequence: Integrate metadata-only BreastDCEDL/I-SPY pCR stress tests.
Map Duke MRI clinical/pathology/treatment context into canonical schema.
Use MIMIC-IV only for missingness/unit/noise priors after credentialed access.
Use ClinVar/BRCA Exchange only for genetics/VUS boundary and schema tests.
Keep GENIE BPC and SEER-Medicare as future restricted-access field contracts until access exists.

datasets.name: BreastDCEDL
datasets.sample_size_if_known: 2070 curated pretreatment DCE-MRI cases from I-SPY1, I-SPY2, and Duke
treatment_fields: neoadjuvant response context through source cohorts
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: strong for imaging-response / pCR stress testing; weak for CBC/symptom timeline monitoring
datasets.target_mismatch: pCR is not the same target as NLCare synthetic response-pattern or toxicity-review heads.
datasets.recommended_use: Use as the first external imaging-response stress benchmark and feature-schema bridge.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not use pCR performance to claim NLCare predicts clinical treatment response or patient outcomes.
datasets.next_integration_step: Create a metadata-only BreastDCEDL integration smoke test before any image-heavy benchmark.

datasets.name: I-SPY2 / TCIA
datasets.sample_size_if_known: TCIA collection with serial MRI; BreastDCEDL-ISPY2 curated subset lists 982 cases
treatment_fields: neoadjuvant chemotherapy / trial-arm context where available
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: best public direction for temporal imaging-response stress testing
datasets.target_mismatch: Trial pCR and MRI-response endpoints do not equal NLCare monitor-only synthetic heads.
datasets.recommended_use: Map serial imaging timepoints into the canonical timeline as response-context stress data.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not infer treatment efficacy, regimen choice, or patient-specific response from NLCare outputs.
datasets.next_integration_step: Implement metadata extraction plan and keep large image download optional.

datasets.name: Duke Breast Cancer MRI / TCIA
datasets.sample_size_if_known: 922 biopsy-confirmed invasive breast cancer patients in the TCIA collection
genetics_fields: limited genomic/radiogenomic context in associated tables
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: strong schema bridge for imaging, pathology, receptor status, treatment, and follow-up context
datasets.target_mismatch: Preoperative imaging cohort, not a patient-portal CBC/symptom monitoring timeline.
datasets.recommended_use: Use as the next public schema bridge after BreastDCEDL for imaging plus treatment-context mapping.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not treat Duke MRI mapping as evidence of clinical response prediction or workflow benefit.
datasets.next_integration_step: Map clinical-and-other-features into canonical oncology schema with target mismatch flags.

datasets.name: MAMA-MIA
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: strong for segmentation/domain-shift stress; indirect for NLCare timeline ML
datasets.target_mismatch: Segmentation benchmark is not a clinical monitoring or toxicity-response dataset.
datasets.recommended_use: Use to test imaging domain shift, segmentation-derived feature robustness, and fairness stress planning.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not present segmentation performance as NLCare clinical monitoring validation.
datasets.next_integration_step: Add a metadata-only MAMA-MIA readiness row before image-processing experiments.

datasets.name: I-SPY1 / ACRIN 6657
datasets.sample_size_if_known: BreastDCEDL integrates 172 I-SPY1 cases; associated radiomics work reports recurrence context
labels_available: recurrence/follow-up context in associated research artifacts
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: useful smaller temporal imaging-response source and recurrence-context stress input
datasets.target_mismatch: Small cohort and imaging-response labels do not match NLCare synthetic monitoring labels.
datasets.recommended_use: Use after BreastDCEDL/I-SPY2 as a smaller imaging-response consistency check.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not use recurrence/follow-up fields for prognosis claims.
datasets.next_integration_step: Keep as secondary check once BreastDCEDL metadata smoke test is stable.

datasets.name: AACR GENIE BPC Breast Cancer
datasets.sample_size_if_known: GENIE BPC Phase 1 linked treatment/pathology/outcomes for nearly 8000 patients across multiple cancers including breast
labels_available: real-world endpoints / outcomes depending on release and access
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: best future bridge for treatment-history + genomic context stress testing
datasets.target_mismatch: Not a CBC/symptom patient-portal timeline and not immediately accessible as a full NLCare training set.
datasets.recommended_use: Prepare a restricted/public access packet and field-contract mapper for treatment-context governance.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not train or claim patient-facing treatment recommendations.
datasets.next_integration_step: Turn existing access packet into a concrete field contract and access checklist.

datasets.name: TCGA-BRCA / NCI GDC
datasets.sample_size_if_known: TCGA breast cancer cohort; molecular characterization across multiple platforms
labels_available: clinical outcome fields with target mismatch
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: strong for molecular schema mapping and subtype-distribution stress
datasets.target_mismatch: Survival/progression fields are target-mismatched for NLCare temporal response and toxicity heads.
datasets.recommended_use: Use for canonical molecular-schema mapping, mutation-context coverage, and target-mismatch education.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not train survival/prognosis models and present them as NLCare monitoring performance.
datasets.next_integration_step: Extend existing cBioPortal/GDC mapping with target-mismatch annotations per model head.

datasets.name: METABRIC
datasets.sample_size_if_known: commonly cited as roughly 2500 breast cancer samples; exact fields depend on portal export
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: useful as independent molecular/subtype distribution stress
datasets.target_mismatch: Survival/outcome data do not validate NLCare monitor-only temporal heads.
datasets.recommended_use: Use as second molecular external cohort for schema consistency and subtype stress.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not call METABRIC survival modeling clinical validation of NLCare.
datasets.next_integration_step: Compare canonical schema field availability against TCGA-BRCA mapping.

datasets.name: CPTAC Breast Cancer
datasets.sample_size_if_known: proteogenomic cohort; file-level availability depends on GDC/PDC access
datasets.target_mismatch: Not a longitudinal treatment-cycle monitoring or CBC/symptom dataset.
datasets.recommended_use: Track as future biomarker/proteogenomics context after simpler bridges are stable.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not add proteomic outputs as patient-facing predictor authority.
datasets.next_integration_step: Keep as roadmap-only until TCGA/METABRIC field mapping is stable.

datasets.name: SEER Breast Cancer / Research Plus
datasets.sample_size_if_known: large population registry; exact cohort depends on SEER*Stat extraction
biomarker_fields: Ki-67 SSDI fields depending on year/extract
datasets.target_mismatch: Registry-level fields are not patient timeline data and must not become prognosis claims.
datasets.recommended_use: Use for subtype/stage/treatment-distribution sanity checks and schema coding discipline.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not use survival endpoints for patient-facing prognosis or response prediction.
datasets.next_integration_step: Prepare field dictionary mapping only; keep as distribution check.

datasets.name: SEER-Medicare
datasets.sample_size_if_known: large linked cancer registry and claims resource; extraction requires approval
biomarker_fields: registry biomarker fields depending on SEER era
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: future restricted-data bridge for treatment-sequence realism
datasets.target_mismatch: Claims are not direct clinical labels, lab trends, symptoms, or imaging-response measures.
datasets.recommended_use: Keep in restricted-data access roadmap for treatment-combination realism.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not imply access has been granted or that claims-derived patterns are treatment advice.
datasets.next_integration_step: Leave in access-packet stage until a supervised data-use route exists.

datasets.name: MIMIC-IV
datasets.sample_size_if_known: large deidentified EHR dataset with hospital/ICU encounters
labels_available: hospital outcomes and encounter context depending on module
imaging_fields: orders/reports only if relevant modules are accessed
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: useful for CBC/lab missingness, units, irregular timing, and EHR pipeline realism
datasets.target_mismatch: General hospital/ICU data are not breast-cancer monitoring or response labels.
datasets.recommended_use: Use only for synthetic-noise and missingness priors after credentialing.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not use MIMIC-IV to train breast cancer response, prognosis, or treatment-selection models.
datasets.next_integration_step: Add a credentialing checklist and lab-unit/missingness extraction plan.

datasets.name: ClinVar
datasets.sample_size_if_known: large public archive of human variant submissions and clinical significance assertions
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: strong for genetics/VUS boundary tests and variant-record schema
datasets.target_mismatch: Variant databases do not provide patient-specific genetic counseling or treatment response labels.
datasets.recommended_use: Use to generate safe VUS wording tests, conflict examples, and genetics-record schema checks.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not interpret a user's variant, infer inherited risk, or provide genetic counseling.
datasets.next_integration_step: Build VUS safety-eval fixtures from public variant-status categories, not patient advice.

datasets.name: BRCA Exchange
datasets.target_match_to_nlcare: useful for BRCA-specific schema and VUS boundary evaluation
datasets.target_mismatch: BRCA variant aggregation is not patient-level inherited-risk interpretation.
datasets.recommended_use: Use as a genetics-boundary and record-normalization reference.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not convert BRCA Exchange classifications into patient-facing risk estimates.
datasets.next_integration_step: Add BRCA-specific schema normalization examples with genetic-counselor-review flags.

datasets.name: NCI EDRN Breast Cancer Reference Set
datasets.sample_size_if_known: case/control reference set for circulating-marker research; specimen access is separate
datasets.target_mismatch: Detection-marker reference context is not treatment-response monitoring.
datasets.recommended_use: Keep as tumor-marker limitation and source-governance context only.
datasets.not_allowed_use: Do not train response predictors or make recurrence/tumor-marker conclusions from this resource.
datasets.next_integration_step: Use only in patient-safe tumor-marker boundary examples and citation policy docs.

claim_boundary: External dataset integration is an engineering roadmap artifact. It ranks public and restricted datasets for schema mapping, stress testing, synthetic-noise design, and future access planning. It does not mean the datasets have been downloaded, licensed, harmonized, used for clinical validation, or approved for patient-facing prediction, diagnosis, treatment, prognosis, genetic-risk interpretation, tumor-marker interpretation, or medication decisions.
